No exact first-integration native conservation, continued unloaded physics, source/binary equivalence, process restart, client/GUI/package/install, denied artifact/cache access, full readiness/regression, owner-state changes or commits/merges. A pass is bounded continuity evidence, not proof of connected rendering/audio/prediction, Creative/uncontrolled combinations, all cargo-loss conditions, safe-speed/no-penetration/5k envelope, six-step adoption, M1/owner acceptance or M2-M6 advancement.
